policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: G seeks $8B valuation in new funding round (Bloomberg)
items.summary: Reporting indicates G is seeking an $8B valuation in a new funding round, implying a valuation reset higher versus prior tracked levels.

items.headline: Bug bounty: O prepared to quadruple rewards for critical findings
items.summary: Credible reporting says O is raising bug bounty rewards for security researchers and is prepared to quadruple payouts for critical findings, reflecting heightened security focus around model/agent risk.

items.headline: GPT-6 Sol & Luna October update strengthens jailbreak resistance
items.summary: O published an October 2026 safety/system-card update stating GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna replace prior ChatGPT versions. It reports stronger resistance to jailbreaks (notably adaptive, multi-turn) and describes applied safeguards.

items.headline: V Series D: $250M raised at ~$1.6B valuation
items.summary: Reuters-reported financing states V raised about $250M at a $1.6B valuation, aimed at scaling microgravity orbital drug manufacturing cadence and partnerships.
